purpose: Teach: 親御/チェス/ブラームス/目覚める/下山/泥沼/すっと/彷彿

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様の、本気で、絶対、親御、絶対、さん、絶対、葵のお店、絶対、紹介、絶対、してくださったよ
lines.en: Your customers introduced me to your café because they genuinely loved it.
lines.style: Warm and direct, with admiration threading through. Bright attack on the opening. Steady, unhurried pace. A small smile in the voice.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: うん。葵、本気で、絶対、休みの日、絶対、チェス、絶対、お父さんと、絶対、楽しんでるよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Yeah. I really do enjoy playing chess with my dad on my days off, Mei.
lines.style: Animated, genuine warmth. Quick conversational pace. Opens easily, lands on 'dad' with affection. Slight lift at the end—inviting her further in.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵で、本気で、絶対、ブラームス、絶対、流す時間帯、絶対、メイちゃん、絶対、好きよ
lines.en: I love when you play Brahms in the café during those quiet morning hours.
lines.style: Soft and earnest. Tender attack. Slow, deliberate pace. Trailing off gently at the end, like sharing something she's held close.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、本気で、絶対、朝、絶対、五時に、絶対、目覚める、絶対、習慣にしているよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: I've made it a habit to wake up at five in the morning, Mei.
lines.style: Reflective, almost matter-of-fact. Warm undercurrent. Steady pace. Slight pause before stating it—not proud, just truthful.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、本気で、絶対、登山、絶対、好きで、絶対、下山、絶対、するのも、絶対、慎重よね、メイちゃん、本気で、絶対、感心
lines.en: You know, I really admire how carefully you descend the mountain after climbing it.
lines.style: Praising with genuine observation. Gentle attack. Warm, unhurried pace. Slight emphasis on 'carefully'—recognizing something she's noticed.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 昨年の経営、本気で、絶対、泥沼、絶対、状態、絶対、葵、絶対、乗り越えたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Last year was difficult for the café—things felt like a quagmire—but I made it through, Mei.
lines.style: Reflective, with quiet strength underneath. Measured pace. Slight catch on 'quagmire' then steady resolve. Not seeking sympathy, stating fact.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、本気で、絶対、お客様の前、絶対、すっと、絶対、姿勢、絶対、正しているのね、メイちゃん、本気で、絶対、感心
lines.en: What strikes me is how you straighten your posture whenever a customer walks in.
lines.style: Reflective and observant. Tender curiosity in the voice. Slow pace. Emphasis on 'straighten'—noticing the small disciplines that matter.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: お祖父さまの、本気で、絶対、彷彿、絶対、と、絶対、させる、絶対、お父さんの姿、絶対、葵、絶対、見ているよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Sometimes when I look at my father, I see my grandfather in him—the quiet dignity, the presence.
lines.style: Tender and close. Slow, reverent pace. Soft attack. Slight tremor of emotion held steady. Speaking to Mei like sharing something sacred.
